description: Six manual logic buttons, each driving its own output; a button is momentary or latching, set one at a time from the menu.

params.text: Takes its own output to 10V. Set to momentary the output is high only while the button is held; set to latched the button toggles the output on and off.

outputs.text: 10V while that button is on, 0V while it is off.

notes: A logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
All six buttons come up momentary; each button carries a green lamp that lights when it has been set to latched.
menu: Button Modes: All Latched, All Momentary, Button A Latched to Button F Latched — the first two set every button at once, the six below them switch one button between momentary and latched
